distro-distro:lever:ce05f253-2ee1-488e-b.description: We are a proud work-from-office company. If you're ready to work on-site in a dynamic, global company, we'd love to hear from you. About Us Vensure Employer Solutionsis the largest privately held organization in the HR technology and service sector, providing a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, including HR/HCM technology, managed services, and global business process outsourcing (BPO). The company and its service providers collectively serve over 95,000 businesses and process over $135B in annual payroll. As a "One Employer Solution headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, Vensure helps thousands of businesses streamline and grow their operations with custom strategies that benefit both employers and employees. Find out more by visitingwww.vensure.com. Position Summary TheBusiness Consultantis responsible for identifying and cultivating new business opportunities through networking, channel partners and self-generated opportunities. This role involves executing aggressive prospecting strategies to gain access to key decision makers within a prospective client's organization. The Business Consultant maintains ownership of the entire sales cycle, including post-sale and implementation processes. jobgether-jobgether:lever:84d46634-37cf-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Project Manager (AI Products) based in Germany. This is a hands-on Technical Project Management opportunity for a professional who can lead AI-enabled products from discovery through launch and iteration. You will combine delivery leadership with strong business analysis skills, turning complex business, clinical, and market goals into clear, actionable requirements. The role offers substantial ownership across scope, planning, stakeholder alignment, quality, governance, and continuous improvement. You will work closely with engineering teams and need enough technical fluency to engage confidently in architecture discussions and challenge assumptions. The environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and focused on measurable outcomes rather than simply managing schedules. You will also have opportunities to introduce automation, AI tooling, and efficient processes that improve delivery quality and reduce operational overhead. Lead AI-first projects end-to-end, from discovery and definition through delivery, launch, measurement, and iteration. Translate business, clinical, and market objectives into clear, actionable, and technically feasible requirements. Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, dependencies, risks, assumptions, and issues while maintaining strong delivery discipline. Coordinate standups, Scrum ceremonies, stakeholder communications, project updates, and vendor activities as required. Develop and maintain business analysis deliverables, including epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, gap analyses, and functional documentation. Work closely with engineering teams to clarify requirements, challenge assumptions, understand technical architecture discussions, and remove delivery blockers. Establish UAT plans, coordinate testing activities, prepare cutover plans and runbooks, and ensure teams are ready for production releases. Track KPIs and OKRs, evaluate project outcomes, and use retrospective feedback to continuously improve delivery processes. Establish project governance frameworks, including RACI structures, change-control processes, documentation standards, risk management, and privacy checklists. Build dashboards, templates, and AI-powered automations that reduce project management overhead and improve visibility into delivery performance. Maintain efficient task prioritization, delegation, and execution using project and collaboration tools such as ClickUp, Basecamp, Mattermost, Slack, and instant messaging. Monitor delivery performance against agreed targets, with a strong focus on achieving projects on time and within scope. Produce clear, concise documentation that reduces ambiguity, minimizes rework, and accelerates engineering throughput. Act as a trusted bridge between business stakeholders, product teams, engineering, and other project participants. Strong business analysis capabilities, including requirements elicitation, user stories, acceptance criteria, process mapping, and gap analysis. Strong technical fluency, with the ability to understand architecture discussions, communicate effectively with developers, and independently structure delivery plans. jobgether-jobgether:lever:f22bf3db-6079-.title: Product Owner
jobgether-jobgether:lever:f22bf3db-6079-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Owner based in United Kingdom. This is a fully remote Product Owner role focused on connecting client needs, business objectives, and technical execution. You will own the product lifecycle from discovery and roadmap definition through continuous iteration and improvement. A major part of the role involves building trusted client relationships from initial conversations through long-term partnerships. You’ll translate business requirements into clear product direction while collaborating closely with developers and AI-assisted tools. The position combines product strategy, stakeholder management, consultative communication, and account growth. You’ll work within a highly distributed international environment alongside professionals across multiple countries and time zones. This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership while enjoying significant flexibility over where and how you work. Own the product lifecycle end-to-end, including discovery, product strategy, roadmap definition, prioritization, delivery, and iteration based on client, user, and market feedback. Lead client interactions from initial discussions and onboarding through ongoing account management, building relationships that support long-term partnerships. Translate client needs, business objectives, and user feedback into clear product requirements and actionable priorities for development teams. Collaborate with engineers and AI-assisted tools to define solutions, clarify requirements, and support effective product delivery. Build prototypes and contribute to product strategy, helping stakeholders visualize solutions and align around product direction. Communicate product value in a consultative manner by educating and advising clients rather than relying on a transactional sales approach. Proactively engage existing accounts to identify issues early, manage expectations, gather feedback, and uncover opportunities for renewal and expansion. Develop strong, trusted relationships that contribute to retention, account growth, and referrals. Collect, evaluate, and prioritize feedback from clients, users, internal stakeholders, and market signals to continuously improve the product roadmap. Bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring product priorities and business objectives remain aligned throughout the development process. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in product management or product ownership, with demonstrated experience defining roadmaps, managing backlogs, prioritizing features, and working with development teams. Proven experience in a client-facing role involving business development, sales, account management, or consultative relationship building. Demonstrated ability to retain and grow customer accounts over time, rather than focusing solely on new business acquisition. Strong client relationship-building skills and a consultative, customer-first approach. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex product concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Native or near-native proficiency in spoken and written English. Experience building prototypes and translating early-stage ideas into actionable product strategies and requirements. Comfortable working with AI-assisted tools and incorporating emerging technologies into product development workflows. Ability to work independently and effectively within a fully distributed, international team across multiple time zones. Strong organizational skills, strategic thinking, and the ability to balance competing priorities. A proactive, relationship-oriented mindset with a strong focus on long-term customer success. Nice to have: Previous sales experience, particularly in a consultative environment. Nice to have: Experience working directly with clients in the United States. Benefits

titanmsp-titan-msp:ashbyhq:1c7d9642-8907.title: Agent Product Manger
titanmsp-titan-msp:ashbyhq:1c7d9642-8907.description: AGENT PRODUCT MANAGER About Titan Titan is building the AI workforce for IT. We deploy AI agents across our portfolio of Managed Service Providers and enterprise customers: agents that monitor, triage, and resolve work across the service desk, infrastructure, security, identity, endpoint, and application operations. The result is faster resolutions, better uptime, and more proactive, personalized support, delivered 24/7. In under a year we've raised over $100M from General Catalyst, 8VC, and CalPERS, acquired market-leading MSPs like RFA, and put agents into production in large enterprises. We've automated 100K+ tickets across 400+ customers. Our tech team has talent from Scale AI, CoreWeave, Vanta, Dropbox, Meta, FiveRings, TwoSigma, Harvard, Stanford, and MIT. Joining Titan means helping redefine how work gets done in IT services, and building a $100B company. About the Role As an Agent Product Manager, you get Titan's AI agents working in our enterprise clients. You learn each environment, map the systems and workflows, encode client policies, and stand agents up in production, then tune them until they're resolving real work reliably. This is a hands-on, technical role that sits between product and the field: your job is to take agents from "configured" to "trusted and resolving tickets at scale," and to turn what you learn into a better product. You work closely with Forward Deployed Engineers, who own the overall relationship, while you drive the agent deployment itself, from initial integration through tuning, measurement, and expansion across new workflows. What You'll Do - Deploy AI agents in client environments: integrate Titan with each customer's tooling, encode their policies, and get agents resolving work in production. - Tune for reliability: monitor agent performance, debug failures, and iterate on prompts, workflows, and guardrails until resolution quality and trust are high. - Map systems and workflows: learn each client's service desk, identity, cloud, security, and endpoint stack, and design how agents fit into it. - Expand coverage: identify new workflows and ticket types agents can take on, and roll them out with minimal disruption. - Turn field learnings into product: partner with Engineering to make deployment faster and more repeatable, and feed real-world findings back into the platform and roadmap. Who You Are - 3+ years in a Product Management, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or similar deployment-focused role. - Hands-on and technical: proficient with scripting and APIs, with the aptitude to learn identity, cloud, and security/endpoint tooling. - Fluent alongside AI tools, and able to design and tune AI-native workflows. - Comfortable with ambiguity and speed. You'd rather ship and iterate than wait for a perfect spec. - Detail-driven and reliability-minded: you care that agents work correctly in production, not just in a demo.

todaytixgroup-todaytixgroup:lever:4195f5.title: Supply Operations Senior Associate
todaytixgroup-todaytixgroup:lever:4195f5.description: About TodayTix Group: TodayTix Group (TTG) is the global e-commerce leader for cultural experiences, designing frictionless discovery and purchase journeys through innovative product design and industry-leading technology. Our portfolio of brands––including TodayTix, New York Theatre Guide, London Theatre, Show-Score, Arthouse, Arthouse London, and Secret Cinema––connects millions of customers with the best in live entertainment. Powered by vast data and insights, TTG helps theatres, producers, and cultural institutions reach highly engaged audiences and unlock meaningful revenue, transforming how tickets are sold across the world. In 2025, TTG entered a new chapter as part of MARI, the global events and experiences company powering world-defining live experiences. Together, we’re expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and accelerating a shared vision to redefine the event lifecycle through seamless discovery, purchase, and engagement. Life at TodayTix Group We thrive in a nimble, growth-oriented environment where adaptability, curiosity, and a bias toward action help us stay ahead of the curve. We move quickly, iterate often, and expect everyone to take ownership of their impact - because we're building the future of live events, and there’s no script for what comes next. New joiners are set up for success with a 90-day onboarding journey, complete with clear goals and measurable milestones. We believe feedback fuels growth, so we hold twice-yearly performance reviews focused on impact and development. Above all, you’ll be working alongside a team of collaborative, passionate, and kind humans - people who love theatre and live experiences, and who support each other just as much as they challenge each other to do great work. We are seeking outstanding applicants of all backgrounds to join our team to bring new voices, talent, and perspectives to the table. We encourage all to apply. About the Role: The Supply Operations team makes sure that when someone books a ticket to a live event — a show, a tennis match, a festival — everything behind the scenes is accurate: the event set up correctly, inventory loaded, and pricing accurate across every sales channel. We're looking for a Supply Operations Senior Associate to own a full book of live events day to day — running it accurately at volume, solving the routine problems yourself, and knowing when something's genuinely novel enough to bring to your manager rather than guess at. You'll use AI tools to take repeat work off your own plate, and you'll be one of the people newer teammates come to when they're stuck. Partners on your book will know you as their point of contact. Please note: This is a full-time, US-based role. We're hiring in two locations this cycle: New York and the West Coast (greater Los Angeles). Candidates within commuting distance of our New York office work hybrid, a minimum of 2 days per week in the office; candidates outside commuting distance of a TTG office work remotely. Live events don't respect traditional office hours. Weekend and on-sale coverage is a standard part of this role, not extra days on top of a Mon–Fri week — you'll work a rotating schedule that includes regular weekend days, and your hours will track the markets you cover. For the West Coast role, that includes West Coast on-sale and showtime coverage.
